archive_close_card: Archive {agent} · {machine} and close it on the computer (its transcript stays; a message resumes it)
agent_modes_bypass_card: Change modes for {agent} · {machine}: {changes} (skips all permission prompts; may restart the session after its current turn)
autoname_card: Use the model to rename {agent} · {machine}. Its current title, including a hand-written one, is replaced; the terminal tab keeps its name.
